analysis.title: GS TMT TODAY 10.12.26
key_insights: Futures flat to start the week (Nasdaq -15bps, S&P +10bps). US fixed income markets are closed for the holiday. WTI is +90bps at $92.70 after Houthi drone and missile strikes on Riyadh airports and continued overnight strikes.

AMZN is in talks to buy AI startup Decart for about $7bn (WSJ). Decart's software makes it easier for developers to switch between AI chips. It was valued at nearly $4bn in May and has raised over $400M in venture funding.
Memory and HDD weakness continues. Korea finished -365bps overnight and MU and SNDK are each about -2% pre-market, each lower in 6 of 7 sessions coming into today.
GS US Sentiment indicator was -1.3 std dev last week, a 'light positioning' signal. The SPX is within 1% of all-time highs while the median S&P stock is 16% below its own high.
The GS Quality factor has rallied more than 16% over the past 8 weeks, a move of this size not seen since the COVID shock in 2020.
Street actions in software: CRM +4% on a BofA upgrade to Buy, ADBE -3% on a Wells Fargo downgrade to Underweight.
MSFT CEO Nadella called for an 'emergency brake' on advanced AI. He said companies should treat powerful models as potential insider threats and assume they could be compromised.

China's CXMT reported 'key progress' on a '4F square' DRAM cell structure and plans a server-memory product based on it by end of 2026. Mainstream DRAM uses a 6F square cell. SK Hynix unveiled a 4F roadmap in 2025 and Samsung reportedly plans mass production by 2028.
Google is preparing to release Gemini 4 'Argon' publicly while staff test a newer internal version called 'Carbon', which one employee said 'feels like Opus 5.5' for coding.

GS Prime Services: hedge funds net sold US Info Tech at the fastest pace in 7 weeks (-1.0 SD 1-year), driven by both long and short sales, most notably on Thursday Oct 8. Tech Hardware and Semis were the most net sold, Software the most net bought.
US Info Tech long/short ratio is 1.8 (-3.8% w/w), the 31st percentile vs the past year and 17th vs five years. Gross/net allocation is 21.5%/20.4%, the 87th/83rd percentile vs the past year.

Callahan: NDX is up 4 weeks in a row and 6 of 7, with VIX in the 14 handle, but Software outperformed Semis by about 800 bps last week. Investors expect earnings beats in Semis and Mag 7 but are less sure of near-term alpha. The compute demand-over-supply bull case still supports 2027+ capex confidence.

Earnings season starts this week with 7% of SPX market cap reporting. Q3 consensus is +27% y/y, the highest estimate since 2021, while the median stock is +9% y/y vs 14% in Q2. Big banks report from Tuesday, ASML Wednesday and TSMC Thursday. CPI is Wednesday and PPI Thursday.

Nasdaq's funding premium to S&P reached a 98% 1-year rank on Oct 8, which suggests leveraged futures buying. Asset managers sold $3.2bn of futures from Sept 8-29 alongside higher prices, which took the usual positive correlation between their gross longs and price to about nil.
Financials have lagged into earnings (XLF -6.5% from highs while SPX hit records). The ratio of recent drawdown to the earnings straddle is about 5x, so the implied earnings move looks cheap.
Index skew is split: VIX upside convexity is very bid while SPX downside convexity is very offered, in a regime of low realized correlation and high dispersion.

EWZ saw over $8bn of volume on Monday, the largest notional day in the fund's 25-year history. Brazil's index is on track for its best week since 2020 on local election flows, with strong interest in EWZS (Brazil small caps).

GS Baskets desk likes buying the Power Up America basket (GSENEPOW), calling power the most underappreciated AI bottleneck. Positioning is low, valuation has normalized and fundamentals are intact, with higher earnings revisions expected as IPPs sign long-term deals with mega-cap tech.

GS Research (Semis - Memory): high-performance NAND including High-Bandwidth Flash could ease the AI 'memory wall'. GS sees a potential TAM of about $40-150B by 2030 at 15%-50% GPU adoption and about 30% lower inference cost per throughput, which could mean several hundreds of billions of hyperscaler capex savings.
Trump declared an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. Zelenskyy said he learned of it from media and that Ukraine will keep striking Russia unless Moscow agrees.

The GS Baskets desk likes the Power Up America basket as an underappreciated AI bottleneck with low positioning, normalized valuation and expected earnings revisions.
XLF is down 6.5% from highs into earnings, and the implied earnings move is cheap relative to the recent drawdown.

earnings_insights: Q3 S&P 500 earnings consensus is +27% y/y, the highest estimate since 2021. The median stock is +9% y/y vs 14% in Q2.

Earnings calendar: Tue 10/13 pre-market Citi, JPM, WFC. Wed 10/14 pre-market ASML, BAC, MS. Thu 10/15 pre-market ERIC, TSM. Fri 10/16 pre-market AXP. Nanya Tech and HCL Tech report pre-market today (10/12).
Consensus expects steady beats across Semis and the Mag 7. GS notes an emerging list of questions on execution, expectations and linearity.
Financials earnings straddle is cheap: the ratio of recent drawdown to the earnings straddle is about 5x.
